import unittest
from solution import PacketTimeline


class ReviewProbe(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_integer_distance_strictly_above_odd_half(self):
        modulus = 2 ** 54 + 3
        last = modulus - 1
        raw = last - (modulus // 2 + 1)
        timeline = PacketTimeline(modulus)
        timeline.push(last)
        self.assertEqual(timeline.push(raw), modulus + raw)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import unittest

from solution import PacketTimeline


class PacketTimelineTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_initial_snapshot_and_first_value(self):
        timeline = PacketTimeline(16)
        self.assertEqual(timeline.snapshot(), (None, 0))
        self.assertEqual(timeline.push(7), 7)
        self.assertEqual(timeline.snapshot(), (7, 0))

    def test_forward_and_equal_values_do_not_change_epoch(self):
        timeline = PacketTimeline(10)
        self.assertEqual([timeline.push(x) for x in (2, 2, 7, 9)], [2, 2, 7, 9])
        self.assertEqual(timeline.snapshot(), (9, 0))

    def test_strictly_more_than_half_backward_is_a_wrap(self):
        timeline = PacketTimeline(10)
        timeline.push(9)
        self.assertEqual(timeline.push(3), 13)
        self.assertEqual(timeline.snapshot(), (3, 10))
        self.assertEqual(timeline.push(8), 18)
        self.assertEqual(timeline.push(1), 21)
        self.assertEqual(timeline.snapshot(), (1, 20))

    def test_exactly_half_backward_is_out_of_order_and_preserves_state(self):
        timeline = PacketTimeline(10)
        timeline.push(9)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            timeline.push(4)
        self.assertEqual(timeline.snapshot(), (9, 0))

    def test_odd_modulus_boundary(self):
        no_wrap = PacketTimeline(9)
        no_wrap.push(8)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            no_wrap.push(4)
        self.assertEqual(no_wrap.snapshot(), (8, 0))

        wraps = PacketTimeline(9)
        wraps.push(8)
        self.assertEqual(wraps.push(3), 12)
        self.assertEqual(wraps.snapshot(), (3, 9))

    def test_small_backward_move_is_rejected_without_mutation(self):
        timeline = PacketTimeline(20)
        timeline.push(12)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            timeline.push(9)
        self.assertEqual(timeline.snapshot(), (12, 0))
        self.assertEqual(timeline.push(13), 13)

    def test_invalid_modulus(self):
        for value in (True, False, 2.0, "10", None):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    PacketTimeline(value)
        for value in (1, 0, -4):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    PacketTimeline(value)

    def test_invalid_raw_values(self):
        timeline = PacketTimeline(8)
        for value in (True, False, 1.0, "1", None):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    timeline.push(value)
        for value in (-1, 8, 20):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    timeline.push(value)
        self.assertEqual(timeline.snapshot(), (None, 0))

    def test_instances_have_independent_state(self):
        first = PacketTimeline(10)
        second = PacketTimeline(10)
        first.push(9)
        first.push(1)
        self.assertEqual(first.snapshot(), (1, 10))
        self.assertEqual(second.snapshot(), (None, 0))
        self.assertEqual(second.push(1), 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
